article.story: BOILING SPRINGS, N.C. -- — Seth Brown’s 23 points helped Gardner-Webb defeat Erskine 88-66 on Wednesday. Brown shot 7 for 13 (4 for 9 from 3-point range) and 5 of 6 from the free-throw line for the Runnin’ Bulldogs (1-2). Mikhail Pocknett added 18 points while shooting 6 of 9 from the field and 6 for 8 from the line to go with eight rebounds. Aaron Talbert had 11 points and went 4 of 6 from the field (3 for 5 from 3-point range). Justen Goudelock finished with 16 points for the Flying Fleet. Noah Castaneda and Andres Vergara each added 10 points for Erskine. Up next Gardner-Webb visits South Carolina in its next matchup on Saturday. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
